# Stack360

> Stack360 is the PE Technology Insights Platform. It sits at the intersection of private
> equity operating partners and portfolio CIOs, revealing how technology investment translates
> into EBITDA and growth, and giving both sides one secure place to benchmark technology
> maturity by industry sector, surface risk, drive synergies, and act on AI-assisted plans.

## What Stack360 is
- A technology intelligence platform purpose-built for private equity and its portfolio-company CIOs.
- Scores every company across 5 domains (AI & Automation, Data Foundation, Technology Foundation, Cyber Posture, IT Talent & Team) and 16 pillars.
- Each domain earns a maturity tier: Deficit, Developing, Advancing, Mastery, Trailblazer (shown to PE as Distressed → Compounding). A company can reach Mastery or Trailblazer in any single domain.
- Quantifies realised EBITDA value created through technology, on the record, so PE partners can see technology value rather than guess at it.

## Who it is for
- PE operating partners: one common language across the portfolio; a central, secure hub for benchmarking, value capture, collaboration and synergy.
- Portfolio CIOs: accelerate roadmaps, benchmark maturity against their industry sector each quarter, surface risk early, and evidence their team's realised EBITDA value.

## How it works
- Assessment across 112 questions produces TechIQ (technology maturity) and CapabilityIQ (sector-specific business capabilities), synthesised at portfolio level as PortfolioIQ.
- Automatic risk flags, cross-portfolio Patterns → Suggested Plays, and an AI layer (Ask Stack360 + AI Analyser) that is permission-scoped, read-only and cited.
- Security by design: tenant isolation and information barriers so CIOs see only their own company and partners see only their own portfolio.
